description: The chart is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of tasks associated with different language-family categories in the context of “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models.” The category axis is vertical (y-axis) and lists language families in a top-to-bottom order that appears sorted by decreasing bar length, including (as visible) IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and a partially visible final category at the bottom; there is no explicit y-axis label shown. The value axis is horizontal (x-axis) labeled “# tasks,” shown on a linear scale with numeric ticks at regular 10-unit intervals (e.g., 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80) spanning approximately 0 to 80. Each category has a single solid-colored bar: IE-Slavic is the longest in light blue at roughly 40 tasks; IE-Romance is dark blue at about 38; IE-Germanic is light green around 35; Uralic is darker green near 20; IE-Baltic is light pink around 17; IE-other is red around 15; IE-Indic is tan around 10; Semitic is orange around 8; Turkic is light purple around 4; and the bottom-most partially visible purple bar is around 3. There is no legend, stacking, or grouping beyond one bar per category, and no bars appear specially emphasized with outlines or annotations.
